questions.question: Verify the claims of priority for arranging combinations in a triangle and inventing the first calculating machine, and the figure of more than fifty Pascalines built.

localizations.source: Verify the claims of priority for arranging combinations in a triangle and inventing the first calculating machine, and the figure of more than fifty Pascalines built.
localizations.ru: Проверить заявления о первом треугольном расположении сочетаний и первой счётной машине, а также число построенных паскалин «более 50».

questions.resolution: Priority claims were removed: the triangular array is stated to have been known earlier, the Pascaline is called one of the earliest mechanical calculators, and the number manufactured is presented as approximate.
